method: Wave 7 (left-out item 16, Chapter 1A density). Table cells of LAMC Chapter 1A Div. 6B.1 and 6B.2 (publication update 2026-08-20), read by the deterministic table reader (no model), checked by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Anthropic API) against each chunk, decided by Claude Opus 5.5 (via Claude Code).

candidates.note: Used only for a lot whose zone string names this Lot-Limited Density District; ADUs and JADUs are exempt (Sec. 6C.1.1 E), named in the explanation.

checks.second_model_explanation: The table gives 1L a maximum of 1 dwelling unit per lot, so the value 1 and unit count are correct. The parameter units_per_lot_max matches the 'Dwelling Units Per Lot (max)' column. The applies_to of 1L is correct. The condition is vague: it names the district type but not the scope limit, that is, the value applies only to lots designated 1L. The excerpt is truncated and cites Sec. 6C.1.1 without its content, so possible exceptions can't be verified. The extraction is accurate but should carry an explicit district-designation precondition and a note that other provisions may modify the cap.

The caveat is that the excerpt is truncated and the number applies only within the 2L district; the engine must verify the lot's district designation and not treat the cap as exclusive of other provisions outside this excerpt.

It does not state that the cap applies only to the L districts and not to lot area-based districts, which the excerpt separates by a heading, nor does it flag that the excerpt is truncated and cross-references Sec. 6C.1.1. The extraction is accurate but should carry that scoping caveat.

checks.second_model_explanation: The row '2 200 100 Applicable' gives 200 min sq ft of lot area per household dwelling unit in Density District 2, 100 for efficiency units, and minimum density as Applicable. The value 200 and the unit sq ft are correct for household units, and the conditions field names household units. The parameter name is generic, though, and the conditions leave out the efficiency-unit value, the mixed-unit allowance, the minimum-density flag, and the cross-references to Sec. 6C.1.2 and 6C.1.3 that may qualify the limit. Hence agree with caveats.
